PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat ? (1 mark)

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Linear Motion ● Terminologies used in linear motion. (distance, displacement, sp.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb? (1 mark)
